name: Cross-Contract Read-Only Reentrancy Attack Recipe
description: Exploit sequence exploiting temporary oracle price dislocation during pool liquidity withdrawal callback.

attack_steps.action: Flashloan large capital and deposit into AMM pool to acquire substantial LP shares.
Trigger remove_liquidity() which transfers ETH or token with receive() callback before pool state settles.
attack_steps.expected_state_delta: pool transfers ETH to attacker contract

attack_steps.action: In receive() fallback callback, call victim lending protocol to borrow assets against temporarily inflated LP collateral valuation.
Execution returns from receive() back to pool, pool completes state cleanup, and attacker repays flashloan with net profit.
attack_steps.expected_state_delta: attacker walks away with stolen funds
